reviewedSequencingRationales.reason: A single transaction locks students in sorted ID order, checks actor scope, then updates points and ledgers. Preserve lock ordering and stop on first failure.
Statements may delete child rows before parent rows. Existing sharedResults tests require order and stopping after the first failure.
Serialize appearance changes so a slow native response cannot overwrite the newest route theme.
The outer Promise.all already runs four workers. Each worker awaits its own request to preserve the concurrency bound.
The pool already runs twelve workers. Retries wait for each failed attempt and its backoff.
Eight pages run in parallel per batch. Waiting between batches bounds requests; retries depend on prior failure.
Each cursor is calculated from the previous page end; the next request cannot be started beforehand.

remainingPolicy: Review each remaining finding in its actual call context. Keep required ordering and bounded concurrency; optimize only independent work. Do not bulk accept, suppress rules, or replace dependent operations with Promise.all.
